sample_results.query: How do I get that individual and business TIN online?
sample_results.normalized_query: How do I get that individual and business TIN online?
sample_results.spoken_reply:
To register an organisation (company, NGO, partnership) for a TIN:
Step 1: Go to U R A dot go dot u g
Step 2: Choose the standard Non-Individual TIN registration option
Step 3: Fill in the organisation's details
Step 4: Attach the incorporation/registration documents
Step 5: Provide the TINs of the directors
Step 6: Submit the application for U R A review

Note: Instant TIN is only available to individuals with a NIN.

sample_results.query: I have hired 4 bakers with monthly salaries of 450,000 UGX each. What tax must I deduct from them?
sample_results.normalized_query: I have hired 4 bakers with monthly salaries of 450,000 UGX each. What tax must I deduct from them?
sample_results.spoken_reply:
Payee calculation, for the 2026 to 2027 financial year
Gross monthly salary: 450,000 Uganda shillings
Payee due (5.6 percent effective): 25 thousand Uganda shillings per month
Net take-home: 425,000 Uganda shillings
Band applied: 25 percent marginal (410,000 Uganda shillings–485,000 Uganda shillings)
This is net of Payee only — N-S-S-F (5 percent), Local Service Tax and any voluntary deductions still come off. Ask again with N-S-S-F included for a closer take-home figure. Statutory Basis: Income Tax Act

Assumptions: resident employee (say “non-resident” if not).
